connector.name: Slack ↔ WxO MCP Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Lifts WxO Slack limits: every-message wake-up, multi-channel MCP. https://markusvankempen.github.io/
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package slack-wxo-mcp-gateway. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the markusvankempen account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
